ops.title: SSHError.Exited accepts daemonkit's no-status terminal (Code -1, Signal 0)
ops.description:
From the sol review of synckit PR #11 at 3fab3a6 (minor). `hostregistry.SSHError.Exited` returns true for `*daemonkit.ExitError` with `Exit.Code == -1 && Exit.Signal == 0`. daemonkit v0.23.0 `internal/proc/driver.go` awaitExit produces that only when `wait4` fails (e.g. ECHILD) or reports neither an exit nor a signal: a local fault that `consent.ProbeRoutesAround` would still skip as peer-offline. Both outcomes deny the approval, so trust is unaffected; only the cause is lost.

Fix: require `exit.Exit.Code >= 0 && exit.Exit.Signal == 0` in `Exited`, add the no-status row to `TestSSHErrorExitedShapes` and a probe-local-failure case, and keep route-around when `DeadlineExceeded` is joined.

ops.text: SSHError.Exited returns false for a no-status ExitError, with a shapes-table row and a consent probe test
Shipped through two reviews and CI
